OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

params.staker: The address whose beneficiary was removed.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params._ownerAddr: The address that can pause and unpause staking.
params._token: The ERC20 token used for staking.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAllowedStaker(address,bool).details: This function is intentionally NOT gated by `whenNotPaused`. Allowlist         mutations remain available during pause so that beneficiaries can revoke         stakers at any time. Note that disallowing a staker who is currently         delegated to the caller will move effective stake attribution back to the         staker, changing ordering-power state even while the contract is paused.Trust assumption: stakers who delegate to a beneficiary implicitly trust         that the beneficiary will not remove them from the allowlist at a         disadvantageous time. Removal triggers `_increasePeData` on the staker,         which resets their `lastUpdate` and thus their accumulated staking weight.

params._staker: The staker to allow or deny.

params._stakers: The stakers to allow or deny.

params._amount: The amount of tokens to stake.
params._beneficiary: Address that receives ordering power from this stake.                     Use msg.sender for self-attribution.

returns._0: The ERC20 token used for staking.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

params._amount: The amount of OP tokens to unstake.

PolicyEngineStaking_InsufficientStake().notice: Thrown when trying to unstake more than the staked amount.

PolicyEngineStaking_NoStake().notice: Thrown when trying to operate with no stake.

PolicyEngineStaking_NotAllowedToSetBenef.notice: Thrown when the staker is not allowed to set the beneficiary.

PolicyEngineStaking_Paused().notice: Thrown when the staking is paused.

PolicyEngineStaking_SameBeneficiary().notice: Thrown when trying to change beneficiary to the current beneficiary.

PolicyEngineStaking_SelfAllowlist().notice: Thrown when trying to allowlist/disallow yourself.

PolicyEngineStaking_ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when a zero address is provided where it is not allowed.

PolicyEngineStaking_ZeroAmount().notice: Thrown when the amount is zero.

PolicyEngineStaking_ZeroBeneficiary().notice: Thrown when the beneficiary address is zero.

BeneficiaryAllowlistUpdated(address,addr.notice: Emitted when a beneficiary updates their allowlist.

BeneficiaryRemoved(address,address).notice: Emitted when a staker's beneficiary is removed (on change or full unstake).

BeneficiarySet(address,address).notice: Emitted when a staker sets their beneficiary.

EffectiveStakeChanged(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when effective stake changes for an account.

Staked(address,uint128).notice: Emitted when a user stakes OP tokens.

Unpaused().notice: Emitted when the staking is unpaused.

Unstaked(address,uint128).notice: Emitted when a user unstakes OP tokens.

PE_DATA_SLOT().notice: Base storage slot for PE data mapping. Policy Engine reads from         keccak256(abi.encode(account, PE_DATA_SLOT)).

changeBeneficiary(address).notice: Changes the beneficiary for existing stake. Reverts if already set         to the same beneficiary.

pause().notice: Pauses the contract. Stake is disabled while paused.

setAllowedStaker(address,bool).notice: Sets whether a staker can set the caller as beneficiary. When disallowing,         if the staker's current beneficiary is the caller, their stake attribution is         moved back to the staker (beneficiary reset to self).

setAllowedStakers(address[],bool).notice: Batch sets allowlist for multiple stakers.

stake(uint128,address).notice: Stakes tokens and sets beneficiary atomically.         This is the entry point for staking. Handles first-time staking,         adding to same beneficiary, and changing to a new beneficiary.

unstake(uint128).notice: Unstakes OP tokens. Supports partial and full unstake.         On full unstake, the beneficiary is automatically cleared.

userdoc.notice: Periphery contract for stake-based transaction ordering in op-rbuilder. Users stake governance tokens         and optionally link to a beneficiary who receives ordering power. Supports partial unstake.         Invariant: every staked token has a beneficiary (self or linked). No receivedStake tracking or unlink().
